Created `/workspace/middleware.ts` with:

- `X-Request-Id` header using `crypto.randomUUID()`
- Console logging of `request.nextUrl.pathname`
- Matcher to skip static files and common non-page assets

The middleware runs on all requests by default (excluding static internals).
